items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Gospel piano style, Andy Crouch and Cleveland and all those guys, the piano players, I love their style.

ctx.x: Central Baptist Church on East Brighton Avenue in Syracuse. Yeah. Well the story for that is I went down to New York to take a trumpet lesson with Carmine Caruso and I took the train back. And on the train back I met a preacher, his name was LeRoy Gainey. And he was from the Bronx, where I live now. And he was going to Syracuse. This wasn’t a trip to Syracuse, but he was about to move to Syracuse to take over this church. So we got to talking and the thing we had in common was basketball. So we started talking…

Gospel piano style, Andy Crouch and Cleveland and all those guys, the piano players, I love their style. But I didn’t practice that stuff. I was more into studying the trumpet. And I was going to school and I was playing basketball. So he brought in another — her name was Minnie Pearl.
